description: Metro de Panamá S.A. - Accidentes e Incidentes de Usuarios en Líneas 1 y 2, años 2017 a 2026 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Metro de Panamá. Datos de Accidentes e Incidentes de Usuarios dentro de la Línea 1 del Metro. Los incidentes en general se refieren a usuarios indispuestos en los vagones del tren o las estaciones del Metro. Incluye datos de utilización del BFU o Botón de Frenado de Urgencia. Informe por mes. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Metro de Panamá. Its tags are BFU, accidentes e incidentes de usuarios, línea 1 y línea 2, usuarios indispuestos. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
